parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, a lightweight and flexible plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, providing flexibility and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the glasses in place on the right side of the wearer’s head and ensures stability.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot around the hinge to fold or unfold, allowing compact storage and easy wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, primarily made of metal for strength and rigidity.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the structural integrity of the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support structure connecting both legs and the nose pads.
